author: TON Core
description: Telegram wallet contract; bytecode stays in config and is updated by validator voting

declarations.name: Revision
declarations.description:
Every time the contract logic is updated,
we append a new revision and provide a new storage migration.
Read `MIGRATION.md`.

declarations.name: MessageToSend
declarations.description:
WalletTg can send up to 255 out messages.
Note: in contrast with w5, which accepts a well-formed c5 register, WalletTg accepts messages.
This is a clearer API, although it costs more gas unless WalletTg is precompiled.

declarations.name: RawArrayOfMessagesToSend
declarations.description:
Bulk requests carry `array<MessageToSend>`, a standard-encoded Tolk array.
The contract parses it manually as a raw slice to avoid materializing the array.

declarations.name: SignedRequest

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Signature of the body with the client's private key.

fields.name: request
fields.description: Body of the incoming message (with opcode and data).

declarations.description:
Every internal/external message is signed by a private key and checked against `storage.publicKey`.
The client-side signing process has three steps.
1. Compose some valid request (body).
2. Sign it with their private key (derived from a mnemonic) — resulting in `signature`.
3. Prepend the signature to the serialized request and send.

Note that signing DIFFERS FROM WALLET V5, where signature lies at the end.
W5 is ABI-unfriendly: we can't describe "signature at the end" after RemainingBitsAndRefs.
Current (Telegram) version is Tolk-friendly, ABI-friendly, and client-friendly.

declarations.name: SeqnoHeader

fields.name: subwalletId
fields.description: Must match `Storage.subwalletId`, so one key can control multiple wallets.

fields.name: validUntil
fields.description:
Unix timestamp until which the message is valid. Must be greater than `blockchain.now`.
Protects against replay after expiration.

fields.name: seqno
fields.description: Seqno protects against replay attacks. Must match `Storage.seqno`.

declarations.description:
Every internal/external request starts with a header.
For instance, it contains seqno to protect against replay attacks.

declarations.name: SendOneMessageRequestI

fields.name: header
fields.description: Header protects against replay attacks.

fields.name: msg
fields.description: A message to send. The contract builds c5 itself.

declarations.description:
Check the signature and forward ONE message.
`MessageToSend` is stored inline, reducing import fee and gas.
Internal (not external) is used for gasless.

declarations.name: ChangePublicKeyRequestI

fields.name: header
fields.description: Header protects against replay attacks.

fields.name: newPublicKey
fields.description: Resets `Storage.publicKey` to this value.

fields.name: rotationSignature
fields.description:
Signed `KeyRotationProofPayload`. The "change key" request is signed twice.
First, by the current key (SignedRequest, the incoming message itself).
Second, by the new key (rotation proof).

declarations.description:
Change the wallet signing key.
Can be repeated: each request is signed by the current key and proven by the new key.
Internal (not external) is used for gasless.

declarations.name: Storage

fields.name: seqno
fields.description:
Seqno protects against replay attacks: every incoming message contains the expected seqno.
Once the contract accepts a message, it bumps storage seqno. Old messages can't be replayed.

fields.name: subwalletId
fields.description:
SubwalletId allows creating multiple wallets for one private key.
Default for mainnet: 0x7FFF7F11; for testnet: 0x7FFF7FFD; for subwallets, consider docs.

fields.name: publicKey
fields.description:
Public key used to check signatures of all incoming messages.
It can be replaced by a signed change-key request.

declarations.description:
Current storage schema of the contract.
A new contract revision bumps its 0xXX prefix and may append new fields.
See `runMigrationAndUpdateC4` about migrations after bytecode upgrade.

get_methods.name: revision
get_methods.description:
Returns current storage revision. It does not trigger migration.
After bytecode upgrade, returns the old revision until the first valid incoming message migrates `c4`.

get_methods.name: seqno
get_methods.description: Returns current seqno from the storage. Bumped on every valid incoming message.

get_methods.name: get_subwallet_id
get_methods.description: Returns the subwallet id from the storage.

get_methods.name: get_public_key
get_methods.description: Returns the public key corresponding to the signer's private key.
